title: Understanding the limits of snapshot-based fault diagnosis in distribution networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.17998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inverter-based resources weaken fault currents in distribution networks, and snapshot-based diagnosis, which classifies a fault from voltage phasors at a few buses at one instant, offers a cheap first-stage screen. Its published accuracies, however, rest on different noise assumptions and do not show whether the error comes from the classifier, the features, the measurement error, or the fault resistance. This paper separates these sources on three IEEE test feeders and a public data set with distributed generation, using four feature sets, thirteen classifiers, and measurement error defined by total vector error classes. The classifier is not the limiting factor, because the full phasor snapshot classifies every fault correctly without noise, and the remaining error comes from measurement error on high-impedance faults. translated_title: 理解配电网络中基于快照的故障诊断的局限性
translated_abstract: 逆变器型资源会削弱配电网络中的故障电流，而基于快照的诊断方法——即利用某一时刻少数母线上的电压相量对故障进行分类——提供了一种低成本的第一阶段筛查手段。然而，已发表的准确率结果建立在不同的噪声假设之上，无法表明误差究竟来自分类器、特征、测量误差还是故障电阻。本文在三个IEEE测试馈线和一个包含分布式发电的公开数据集上，使用四种特征集、十三个分类器以及由总矢量误差（TVE）等级定义的测量误差，对这些误差来源进行了系统分离。结果表明，分类器并非限制因素，因为在无噪声条件下完整的相量快照能够正确分类所有故障，剩余误差来自高阻抗故障上的测量误差。三个电压传感器在1%精度等级下可分类90-96%的故障，采用配电微型相量测量单元时可达96-99%。
tldr: 本文通过系统分离分类器、特征、测量误差和故障电阻等误差来源，首次揭示了基于快照的配电网络故障诊断的性能瓶颈在于测量误差（尤其是高阻抗故障）而非分类器本身。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically disentangles the sources of error in snapshot-based distribution network fault diagnosis, revealing that measurement error—rather than the classifier—is the limiting factor, particularly for high-impedance faults.
